# PalmVille Agro Real Estate

> Managed oil-palm plantation land ownership in Obafemi-Owode, Ogun State, Nigeria — powered by LIFEPAGE Agro Real Estate Limited and presented with 9jawealth Advisory.

## Key Facts & Offerings
- **Location:** Obafemi-Owode, Ogun State, Nigeria (1,000 hectares total estate scale)
- **Developer / Operator:** LIFEPAGE Agro Real Estate Limited (RC 1309181339)
- **Advisory Partner:** 9jawealth (Olanrewaju Yinusa) — https://www.9jawealth.com/education

## Published Pre-Launch Pricing (Outright, 3 Months, 6 Months)
- **1 Plot (500 sqm):** Outright ₦2,000,000 | 3 Months ₦2,100,000 | 6 Months ₦2,300,000
- **6 Plots (1 Acre):** Outright ₦6,000,000 | 3 Months ₦6,200,000 | 6 Months ₦6,500,000
- **15 Plots (1 Hectare):** Outright ₦15,000,000 | 3 Months ₦15,500,000 | 6 Months ₦16,000,000
- **Flexible 12-Month Payment Option:** Available on request; written schedule confirmed prior to subscription.

## Value Stack Highlights
- **1 Plot (₦3,000,000 total package value):** Land Value (₦2,000,000), Deed of Assignment & Registered Survey (₦1,000,000), BOQ, Agro-Real Estate Community, 5-year Expert Supervision & Management, Project Insurance & Security.
- **6 Plots (₦20,000,000 total package value):** Land Value (₦7,500,000), Deed & Registered Survey (₦6,000,000), Discount Voucher (₦500,000), Free 200sqm Resort Plot (₦1,000,000), Architectural Drawing (₦3,000,000), BOQ (₦2,000,000), plus community, supervision, and insurance.
- **15 Plots (₦41,750,000 total package value):** Land Value (₦18,000,000), Deed & Registered Survey (₦15,000,000), Discount Voucher (₦1,250,000), Free 500sqm Resort Plot (₦2,500,000), Architectural Drawing (₦3,000,000), BOQ (₦2,000,000), plus community, supervision, and insurance.

## Harvest Timeline & Revenue Model (Non-Guaranteed Projections)
- **Fruiting & Harvest:** Oil palm trees begin fruiting within 4–5 years; projected first harvest payouts begin from Year 6 onward across a 25–40+ year productive tree lifespan.
- **Yield Split:** 60% of net harvest proceeds to landowner, 40% to plantation management & operations.
- **Projected Scale Economics (2026 assumptions based on ₦2,400/litre baseline; non-guaranteed):**
  - 1 Plot (500 sqm): 10 trees, 250 litres, ₦600,000 estimated annual revenue, ₦240,000 estimated 40% processing & operational cost.
  - 1 Acre (6 Plots): 60 trees, 1,500 litres, ₦3,600,000 estimated annual revenue, ₦1,440,000 estimated 40% processing & operational cost.
  - 1 Hectare (15 Plots): 150 trees, 3,750 litres, ₦9,000,000 estimated annual revenue, ₦3,600,000 estimated 40% processing & operational cost.
